name: agentx
description: AgentX plugins for Claude Code — production tracing for your own agent, and evaluation triage against a self-hosted AgentX engine

plugins.name: agentx
plugins.description: Get your agent's real runs into AgentX, then turn what they measure into a code fix. /agentx-add-tracing instruments a Python agent; /eval-fix triages an evaluation against the source and re-runs it on the same dataset.
